info.name: AddressGuru – Follow Up APIs
info.description: Complete API collection for Follow Up Logs and Follow Up Config (Activity Options Settings)

item.name: 📋 Follow Up Config (Settings)
item.description:
Manage activity options that appear in the Follow Up modal. Admin use only.

Base path: /api/followup-config

There is ONE shared config (module: 'lead') used across ALL listing types.
No module param needed in any config route.

request.description:
Fetch all follow-up activity options from the single shared config (module: 'lead').

This config is shared across ALL listing types: BusinessListing, MarketplaceListing, PropertyListing, JobListing.

On first call, auto-seeds default options if none exist.

Used by FollowUpModal.jsx to load options dynamically.

response.name: 200 – Success (with seeded defaults)

request.description:
Add a new activity option to the shared follow-up config.

No module param needed — always operates on the single 'lead' config.

Fields:
- label (required): Display text shown in modal
- hasRemark: Show remark textarea when this option is selected
- remarkRequired: Force agent to fill remark before submitting
- remarkPlaceholder: Custom placeholder text in remark box

response.name: 201 – Option Added

body.raw:
{
  "label": "Call Back Later",
  "hasRemark": true,
  "remarkRequired": false,
  "remarkPlaceholder": "When should we call back?",
  "isActive": true
}

request.description:
Update any field of an existing option.

No module param needed — always operates on the single 'lead' config.

All fields are optional — send only what you want to change.

Note: If you set hasRemark to false, remarkRequired is automatically set to false too.

Disable or enable an option without deleting it.

isActive: false → hidden from modal
isActive: true  → visible in modal

Same endpoint as Update Option, just send only isActive.

Permanently delete an activity option from the shared config.

No module param needed.

Warning: This cannot be undone. Previously logged follow-ups that used this option will still show the label correctly because the label is snapshotted at log time.

Reorder activity options by passing an array of option IDs in the desired order.

No module param needed — always operates on the single 'lead' config.

The index in the array becomes the new `order` value for each option.

Useful when you implement drag-and-drop in FollowUpSettings.

item.name: 📞 Follow Up Logs
item.description:
Create and retrieve follow-up log entries. These are created when an agent submits the FollowUpModal.

Base path: /api/followups

NOTE: All create/get-by-listing routes require ?module= query param.
Valid values: BusinessListing | MarketplaceListing | PropertyListing | JobListing

NOTE: GET /listing/:listingId is registered BEFORE GET /:id to avoid Express matching 'listing' as an ID.

request.description:
Log a new follow-up for a Business Listing.

The ?module= query param is required and tells the controller which module to store on the log.

The activityOptionId is validated against the single shared 'lead' config.

The controller will:
1. Validate module is one of the 4 valid listing types
2. Validate listingId and activityOptionId are present
3. Fetch the shared FollowUpConfig (module: 'lead') and validate the option
4. Check if remark is required for that option
5. Snapshot the label so history stays accurate even if option is renamed later
6. Save and return the populated log

Requires: auth middleware — createdBy is taken from req.user.id

response.name: 201 – Follow Up Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Follow-up logged successfully",
  "data": {
    "_id": "64fu001",
    "listing": "69bd1aeba350f63562a43ed8",
    "module": "BusinessListing",
    "activityOptionId": "opt002",
    "reason": "Talk With My Partner",
    "remark": "Client said they will discuss with partner and get back by Friday.",
    "nextFollowUpDate": "2026-03-25T10:00:00.000Z",
    "isDeleted": false,
    "createdBy": {
      "_id": "user001",
      "name": "Ayush Gupta",
      "email": "ayush@addressguru.com"
    },
    "createdAt": "2026-03-20T12:30:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-03-20T12:30:00.000Z"
  }
}

response.name: 400 – Missing or Invalid Module
404 – Config Not Found

item.name: Get All Follow Ups for a Listing (BusinessListing)

request.description:
Get all follow-up logs for a specific Business Listing.

?module= is required — filters results to only this module so a PropertyListing and a BusinessListing with the same ObjectId never bleed into each other.

Returns newest first (createdAt: -1).
Only returns non-deleted logs (isDeleted: false).

NOTE: This route /listing/:listingId is registered BEFORE /:id in the router to avoid Express matching 'listing' as an ID param.

item.name: Get Single Follow Up by ID

request.description:
Get a single follow-up log by its MongoDB _id.

No module param needed — _id is globally unique.

Includes populated createdBy (name, email).

Returns 404 if not found.

response.name: 200 – Found
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "_id": "64fu001",
    "listing": "69bd1aeba350f63562a43ed8",
    "module": "BusinessListing",
    "reason": "Interested",
    "remark": "Very interested in the premium plan.",

request.description:
Soft-delete a follow-up log by setting isDeleted: true.

The record is NOT removed from the database.
It will no longer appear in GET /listing/:listingId results.

No module param needed — _id is globally unique.

Admin only.
